martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, Sunday evening is looking perfect for a run - 19:00 to 21:00 is your window, with ideal temps and calm wind. It's a bit humid, but that's a small price to pay for a great run. Drag Britt along if you can, and maybe pack a cold one for afterwards.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, Sunday vibes call for a great run, and today's your day - the conditions are perfect from 19:00 to 21:00, with ideal temps and calm wind. You might even drag Martha along for a sunset jog. Just watch out for possible rain later, but for now, get those running shoes ready.
